title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits

body: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model's current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy's intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. Although intervention trajectories are inherently off-policy, we find that they can effectively guide policy optimization when trajectories with excessive distributional shifts are filtered out. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that RTI consistently outperforms RL baselines, enabling the post-trained policy to approach the performance of substantially stronger contemporary LLMs and, more importantly, transcend its original capability boundary. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr.
summaryZh: 本文提出了“Rollout-Time Intervention”（RTI）技术，旨在解决大模型智能体在强化学习训练中面临的探索瓶颈。RTI通过在推理过程中利用奖励信号对错误轨迹进行干预，将其转化为成功轨迹，从而为模型提供有效的学习信号。实验表明，该方法能使模型超越其原始的探索能力，在多个基准测试中表现出优于传统强化学习基线的性能。该研究为提升智能体在复杂交互环境中的推理与规划能力提供了新的训练范式。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出的Rollout-Time Intervention技术有效解决了智能体强化学习中的探索瓶颈，提升了模型在复杂任务中的表现。

glossary.explanationZh: 推理时干预，指在模型生成过程中通过外部信号修正轨迹的技术。
强化学习，一种通过奖励机制训练智能体决策能力的机器学习方法。
同策略，指训练数据由当前策略直接生成。
探索能力，指智能体在环境中尝试新行为的能力。
分布偏移，指训练数据分布与模型实际运行环境分布不一致的现象。
